note: Breckinridge County PVA parcels are published only through the qPublic (Schneider Corp) web viewer, which is not a queryable ArcGIS REST or file service and blocks automated access (403/bot check). No Breckinridge PVA parcel service appears on kygisserver.ky.gov WGS84WM_Services (which has Webster, Hardin and other PVA parcel services but none for Breckinridge), on KGS's PVA service catalog, or in ArcGIS Hub/Online searches. Only commercial vendors (Regrid, ReportAll, DynamoSpatial, Acres) offer parcel data for the county.
